name: a2a-and-mcp-integration-health-auditor
description: Audits registered remote A2A agents, custom MCP servers, and generic webhooks for health, staleness, over-broad scope, and security posture (authenticated, least-privilege, still used), ranking the risky and unused extension points so the platform team can retire or tighten them. Read-only.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 17:35 UTC
